title: The People in the Sentence
label: ch:ml-aalukal
canDo: I can talk about somebody who is not in the room, at either level of respect, and I can say we in the two ways Malayalam requires.

payoff.summary: From cold: the five third-person and we-words, the front letter that points away, and the question each choice answers.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three, with nothing open in front of the reader.
